name: Velun
description: A tidally locked ice world — one face always burning, the other frozen solid. The warm side cracked open centuries ago and the mining colony followed, boring deep into the fault lines. The tunnels go further down than the original survey said they would.

name: Mireth
description: Used to be survivable. Now Quases bakes it from above and the cracked desert surface just holds the heat. The garrison was the last functioning authority in this part of the system — whoever was stationed here didn't leave in an orderly fashion.

name: Crael
description: The rings aren't ice. They're glass — what's left of a moon that came apart about three hundred years ago, nobody agrees on why. The ore processing operation out here kept running on automated systems long after the crew left. Some of it still is.

name: Presso
description: The atmosphere here will dissolve unshielded equipment in about four hours. The mining rigs were built to handle it — heavily armoured, mostly autonomous, and apparently still cycling. Someone should have switched them off.
